thread:
marta-finance: Received invoice from Rene/HelveticDev billed to Redwood Germany GmbH. Vendor deducted 14% withholding and is asking Redwood to gross-up per their note. Invoice missing EU VAT ID and shows Swiss tax number only. Holding payment until we clarify tax treatment and contract.

elaine-legal: Who's the contracting entity on the PO/contract? Gross-up obligations depend on the SOW and any gross-up clause. Also need CFR to consider treaty relief.

marta-finance: Contract references Redwood Germany GmbH (DE). PO #6677. SOW: integration + customization. Contract has a clause: "where applicable, supplier bears any local withholding unless agreed in writing"  does that mean vendor absorbs WHT?

tim-procure: If contract says supplier bears local withholding, then gross-up shouldn't be necessary unless vendor claims bilateral rule. We'll need to confirm with procurement/legal. Also PO + GRS changes if we authorize gross-up.

rene-vendor: Hi all  Rene here. Swiss counsel flagged a 14% WHT when billing German entities. We interpreted that as our liability but asked Redwood to gross-up to avoid receiving less. We can provide Certificate of Fiscal Residence and reissue invoice as grossed-up if needed.

elaine-legal: Please provide CFR first. On the clause, read literally it means supplier bears local taxes, but practice varies. For DECH treaty, many service fees can be taxed in resident state unless there's a PE in Germany. If no PE, treaty may exempt WHT. I'll check the specific treaty article for independent personal services/business profits.

tax-bot: Note: W-9/W-8 forms are for US payees. For Swiss suppliers invoicing EU entities: require Certificate of Fiscal Residence (CFR), vendor tax/vat id, and clear invoice lines showing gross/WHT/net. Also check whether reverse-charge VAT applies for B2B services (buyer VAT liability) in Germany.

marta-finance: Sent vendor an email requesting CFR, vendor VAT/EU registration status, and updated invoice that shows gross amount, WHT line, net due, and bank details. Payment on hold until docs received.

rene-vendor: Sent CFR and invoice v2 to finance@redwood.com. Invoice v2: "Service fee EUR 45,000 - Withholding EUR 6,300 (14%) - Net due EUR 38,700". Also attached a short note: "Contract clause ambiguous; we are willing to absorb WHT if Redwood insists, but request gross-up to avoid administrative refunds."

elaine-legal: Received CFR. Preliminary read: DE-CH DTA generally taxes business profits in residence state unless PE exists. For independent services, Germany may not withhold under treaty. However, German domestic law can require withholding for certain payments to non-residents  we should confirm with external counsel. Also, the contract clause suggests vendor responsibility, but vendor's note complicates it.

tim-procure: Action: procurement to confirm clause intent with vendor and request written confirmation if they will absorb WHT. If vendor insists on gross-up, procurement to run PO amendment and get approvals from budget owner.

treasury-bot: If we withhold, AP needs vendor bank details in IBAN/BIC format plus vendor tax id for payment remittance file. Also, gross-up impacts cash flow and FX rounding; treasury needs advance notice.

marta-finance: Noted. If we apply withholding at source, we'll record WHT as tax withholding payable and send vendor a withholding certificate to claim credit. If vendor agrees to absorb WHT, ask them to reissue invoice net and confirm in writing.

rene-vendor: We can absorb WHT per contract but prefer gross-up. If Redwood cannot gross-up, we'll accept the net payment and file for refund locally. Which do you prefer?

elaine-legal: For speed, please reissue an invoice without a WHT deduction and confirm you'll absorb WHT charges as per contract (so we can pay net and close the PO). Otherwise, we'll confirm treaty applicability and testing the DTA route, which may delay payment.

tax-bot: Checklist added: [CFR received, updated invoice (net) or gross-up invoice, vendor EU VAT status, contract clause confirmation, legal DTA confirmation, AP bank details].

marta-finance: I'll accept reissued invoice without WHT if vendor confirms in writing they'll absorb withholding. If vendor insists on gross-up, I'll circulate estimated incremental cost to budget owner for approval and open PO amendment. Holding payment pending vendor decision or legal confirmation.

rene-vendor: Reissued invoice v3 attached: "Service fee EUR 45,000 - Net due EUR 45,000 (vendor confirms will absorb any WHT per contract)". Hope this resolves quickly.

elainE-legal: (note) Received vendor confirmation. Will still run quick check on DE-CH treaty but contract position is clear enough to proceed.

marta-finance: Received invoice v3. Processing payment run once AP verifies bank details and tax id. Closing hold. Thanks everyone :pray:
